"""Comprehensive tests for HermesP2P."""

import os
import time
import pytest

from hermes_p2p.bloom import BloomFilter
from hermes_p2p.channels import DirectMessage, PrivateChannel, PublicChannel
from hermes_p2p.crypto import (
    generate_keypair,
    generate_x25519_keypair,
    symmetric_encrypt,
    symmetric_decrypt,
    sign,
    verify,
    asymmetric_encrypt,
    asymmetric_decrypt,
)
from hermes_p2p.message import Message, MessageEnvelope, CLOCK_SKEW_TOLERANCE
from hermes_p2p.node import Node
from hermes_p2p.network import Network
from hermes_p2p.onion import OnionRouter


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Helpers
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def make_node(node_id=None, fanout=3):
    """Create a Node with optional explicit id."""
    n = Node(fanout=fanout)
    if node_id is not None:
        n.node_id = node_id
    return n


def make_network(n_nodes=5, fanout=3, latency=0.0, packet_loss=0.0):
    """Create a Network with *n_nodes* fully-connected nodes."""
    net = Network(latency=latency, packet_loss=packet_loss)
    nodes = []
    for _ in range(n_nodes):
        node = make_node(fanout=fanout)
        net.add_node(node)
        nodes.append(node)
    # Fully connect all nodes
    for i, n1 in enumerate(nodes):
        for j, n2 in enumerate(nodes):
            if i != j:
                net.connect(n1, n2)
    return net, nodes


# ===========================================================================
# (a) Message reaches all subscribers within TTL
# ===========================================================================

class TestMessageReachesSubscribers:
    def test_gossip_reaches_all_nodes_in_full_mesh(self):
        """In a fully-connected 5-node mesh every node should receive a broadcast."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=5, fanout=3)
        sender = nodes[0]
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="test-channel", payload=b"hello world")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=5)
        sender.broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        for node in nodes[1:]:
            assert node.has_received(msg.message_id), (
                f"Node {node.node_id} did not receive the message"
            )

    def test_gossip_reaches_nodes_in_chain_topology(self):
        """Messages propagate along a chain A-B-C-D with sufficient hops."""
        net = Network()
        a, b, c, d = [make_node(fanout=3) for _ in range(4)]
        for n in (a, b, c, d):
            net.add_node(n)
        net.connect(a, b)
        net.connect(b, c)
        net.connect(c, d)

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="chain", payload=b"chain-msg")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=10)
        a.broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()

        assert d.has_received(msg.message_id)

    def test_message_within_ttl_is_accepted(self):
        """A fresh message (created now) is accepted by a receiving node."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=2)
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"ok")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=3)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        assert nodes[1].has_received(msg.message_id)


# ===========================================================================
# (b) Expired messages are dropped
# ===========================================================================

class TestTTLEnforcement:
    def test_expired_message_is_dropped(self):
        """A message whose TTL has elapsed must be silently dropped."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=2)
        msg = Message(
            ttl_seconds=1,
            channel_id="ch",
            payload=b"expired",
            created_ts=time.time() - 100,  # created 100 s ago, TTL=1
        )
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=3)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        assert not nodes[1].has_received(msg.message_id)

    def test_message_within_clock_skew_tolerance_accepted(self):
        """A message barely within the clock-skew window is accepted."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=2)
        # created_ts is ttl_seconds ago minus a bit, but within 30 s tolerance
        now = time.time()
        msg = Message(
            ttl_seconds=10,
            channel_id="ch",
            payload=b"skew-ok",
            created_ts=now - 10 - (CLOCK_SKEW_TOLERANCE - 1),
        )
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=3)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        assert nodes[1].has_received(msg.message_id)

    def test_message_outside_clock_skew_tolerance_dropped(self):
        """A message beyond the clock-skew window is dropped."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=2)
        now = time.time()
        msg = Message(
            ttl_seconds=10,
            channel_id="ch",
            payload=b"skew-bad",
            created_ts=now - 10 - CLOCK_SKEW_TOLERANCE - 10,
        )
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=3)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        assert not nodes[1].has_received(msg.message_id)

    def test_ttl_zero_message_is_immediately_expired(self):
        """A message with TTL=0 should be expired on receipt (beyond skew)."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=2)
        msg = Message(
            ttl_seconds=0,
            channel_id="ch",
            payload=b"instant-expire",
            created_ts=time.time() - CLOCK_SKEW_TOLERANCE - 1,
        )
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=3)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        assert not nodes[1].has_received(msg.message_id)


# ===========================================================================
# (c) Duplicate messages are deduplicated
# ===========================================================================

class TestDeduplication:
    def test_duplicate_message_not_processed_twice(self):
        """Sending the same envelope twice should only be processed once."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=2)
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"dup")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=3)

        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        count_first = nodes[1].received_count(msg.message_id)

        # Broadcast the exact same envelope again
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        count_second = nodes[1].received_count(msg.message_id)

        assert count_first == 1
        assert count_second == 1  # still 1, not 2

    def test_bloom_filter_dedup_basic(self):
        """BloomFilter.add / .contains works for deduplication."""
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=1000, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        assert not bf.contains("msg-1")
        bf.add("msg-1")
        assert bf.contains("msg-1")

    def test_bloom_filter_no_false_negatives(self):
        """Bloom filters must never have false negatives."""
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=500, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=120)
        ids = [f"id-{i}" for i in range(500)]
        for mid in ids:
            bf.add(mid)
        for mid in ids:
            assert bf.contains(mid), f"False negative for {mid}"


# ===========================================================================
# (d) Onion routing: intermediate relays cannot read payload
# ===========================================================================

class TestOnionRouting:
    def test_intermediate_relay_cannot_read_payload(self):
        """Each relay can only peel its layer; it never sees the plaintext."""
        # Generate keys for 3 relays + recipient
        relay_keys = [generate_x25519_keypair() for _ in range(3)]
        recipient_keys = generate_x25519_keypair()

        relay_pub_keys = [k[1] for k in relay_keys]  # public keys
        recipient_pub = recipient_keys[1]

        plaintext = b"secret message for the recipient"

        # Build onion packet
        route_public_keys = relay_pub_keys + [recipient_pub]
        packet = OnionRouter.build_onion(
            plaintext=plaintext,
            route_public_keys=route_public_keys,
        )

        original_size = len(packet)

        # Relay 1 peels
        next_hop_1, packet_1 = OnionRouter.peel_layer(packet, relay_keys[0][0])
        assert plaintext not in packet_1, "Relay 1 should not see plaintext"
        assert len(packet_1) == original_size, "Packet size must remain constant"

        # Relay 2 peels
        next_hop_2, packet_2 = OnionRouter.peel_layer(packet_1, relay_keys[1][0])
        assert plaintext not in packet_2, "Relay 2 should not see plaintext"
        assert len(packet_2) == original_size, "Packet size must remain constant"

        # Relay 3 peels
        next_hop_3, packet_3 = OnionRouter.peel_layer(packet_2, relay_keys[2][0])
        assert plaintext not in packet_3, "Relay 3 should not see plaintext"
        assert len(packet_3) == original_size, "Packet size must remain constant"

        # Recipient decrypts
        result = OnionRouter.decrypt_final(packet_3, recipient_keys[0])
        assert result == plaintext

    def test_onion_single_hop(self):
        """Onion with one relay + recipient."""
        relay_keys = generate_x25519_keypair()
        recipient_keys = generate_x25519_keypair()

        plaintext = b"single hop secret"
        packet = OnionRouter.build_onion(
            plaintext=plaintext,
            route_public_keys=[relay_keys[1], recipient_keys[1]],
        )

        _, peeled = OnionRouter.peel_layer(packet, relay_keys[0])
        result = OnionRouter.decrypt_final(peeled, recipient_keys[0])
        assert result == plaintext

    def test_constant_size_packets(self):
        """All intermediate packets must have the same size."""
        keys = [generate_x25519_keypair() for _ in range(5)]
        pub_keys = [k[1] for k in keys]
        plaintext = b"test constant size"
        packet = OnionRouter.build_onion(plaintext, pub_keys)

        sizes = [len(packet)]
        current = packet
        for i in range(len(keys) - 1):
            _, current = OnionRouter.peel_layer(current, keys[i][0])
            sizes.append(len(current))

        assert len(set(sizes)) == 1, f"Packet sizes vary: {sizes}"


# ===========================================================================
# (e) Bloom filter bounds memory usage
# ===========================================================================

class TestBloomFilterMemory:
    def test_bloom_filter_size_is_bounded(self):
        """The bloom filter's memory does not grow with the number of insertions."""
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=1000, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        initial_size = bf.memory_bytes()

        for i in range(5000):  # insert 5x expected items
            bf.add(f"item-{i}")

        final_size = bf.memory_bytes()
        # Memory should be bounded; it should not grow linearly with inserts
        # Allow up to 3x because of generation rotation creating a new array
        assert final_size <= initial_size * 3, (
            f"Memory grew too much: {initial_size} -> {final_size}"
        )

    def test_bloom_filter_rotation_evicts_old_entries(self):
        """After TTL expiry and rotation, old entries should be evicted."""
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=1)
        bf.add("old-item")
        assert bf.contains("old-item")

        # Simulate passage of time by manipulating internal timestamps
        # Force rotation
        bf._force_rotate()
        bf._force_rotate()  # Two rotations should evict the old generation

        # After two rotations the item should be gone
        assert not bf.contains("old-item")

    def test_bloom_filter_false_positive_rate_reasonable(self):
        """FP rate should be in the expected ballpark."""
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=1000, fp_rate=0.05, ttl_seconds=300)
        for i in range(1000):
            bf.add(f"present-{i}")

        fps = sum(1 for i in range(10000) if bf.contains(f"absent-{i}"))
        fp_rate = fps / 10000
        # Should be roughly <=0.10 (2x target to account for two generations)
        assert fp_rate < 0.15, f"False-positive rate too high: {fp_rate:.3f}"


# ===========================================================================
# (f) Public channel messages verified by signature
# ===========================================================================

class TestPublicChannelSignature:
    def test_public_channel_sign_and_verify(self):
        """Messages on a public channel are signed by the sender and can be verified."""
        priv, pub = generate_keypair()
        channel = PublicChannel(channel_id="public-1")

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="public-1", payload=b"announcement")
        signed_msg = channel.sign_message(msg, priv)

        assert channel.verify_message(signed_msg, pub)

    def test_public_channel_tampered_payload_rejected(self):
        """Tampering with a signed message causes verification to fail."""
        priv, pub = generate_keypair()
        channel = PublicChannel(channel_id="public-1")

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="public-1", payload=b"original")
        signed_msg = channel.sign_message(msg, priv)

        # Tamper with the payload
        signed_msg.payload = b"tampered"
        assert not channel.verify_message(signed_msg, pub)

    def test_public_channel_wrong_key_rejected(self):
        """Verifying with a different key fails."""
        priv1, pub1 = generate_keypair()
        priv2, pub2 = generate_keypair()
        channel = PublicChannel(channel_id="pub")

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="pub", payload=b"data")
        signed_msg = channel.sign_message(msg, priv1)
        assert not channel.verify_message(signed_msg, pub2)


# ===========================================================================
# (g) Private channel messages unreadable without channel key
# ===========================================================================

class TestPrivateChannel:
    def test_private_channel_encrypt_decrypt(self):
        """Members with the channel key can decrypt private channel messages."""
        channel_key = os.urandom(32)
        channel = PrivateChannel(channel_id="private-1", channel_key=channel_key)

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="private-1", payload=b"secret data")
        encrypted_msg = channel.encrypt_message(msg)
        decrypted = channel.decrypt_message(encrypted_msg)

        assert decrypted.payload == b"secret data"

    def test_private_channel_wrong_key_fails(self):
        """Without the correct channel key, decryption should fail."""
        channel_key = os.urandom(32)
        wrong_key = os.urandom(32)
        channel = PrivateChannel(channel_id="priv", channel_key=channel_key)
        wrong_channel = PrivateChannel(channel_id="priv", channel_key=wrong_key)

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="priv", payload=b"classified")
        encrypted_msg = channel.encrypt_message(msg)

        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            wrong_channel.decrypt_message(encrypted_msg)

    def test_private_channel_encrypted_payload_is_not_plaintext(self):
        """The encrypted message payload should not contain the plaintext."""
        channel_key = os.urandom(32)
        channel = PrivateChannel(channel_id="priv", channel_key=channel_key)

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="priv", payload=b"visible secret")
        encrypted_msg = channel.encrypt_message(msg)

        assert b"visible secret" not in encrypted_msg.payload


# ===========================================================================
# (h) New node successfully bootstraps and receives messages
# ===========================================================================

class TestBootstrap:
    def test_new_node_discovers_peers_via_bootstrap(self):
        """A new node connecting to a bootstrap node discovers other peers."""
        net = Network()
        bootstrap_node = make_node()
        net.add_node(bootstrap_node)

        existing = make_node()
        net.add_node(existing)
        net.connect(bootstrap_node, existing)

        # New node bootstraps
        new_node = make_node()
        net.add_node(new_node)
        net.bootstrap(new_node, [bootstrap_node])
        net.deliver_all()

        # new_node should know about existing node
        assert new_node.knows_peer(existing.node_id) or new_node.knows_peer(bootstrap_node.node_id)

    def test_bootstrapped_node_receives_messages(self):
        """After bootstrap, the new node should receive gossiped messages."""
        net = Network()
        nodes = []
        for _ in range(3):
            n = make_node(fanout=3)
            net.add_node(n)
            nodes.append(n)

        # Fully connect existing nodes
        for i in range(len(nodes)):
            for j in range(len(nodes)):
                if i != j:
                    net.connect(nodes[i], nodes[j])

        # Bootstrap a new node
        new_node = make_node(fanout=3)
        net.add_node(new_node)
        net.bootstrap(new_node, [nodes[0]])
        net.deliver_all()

        # Now send a message
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"after bootstrap")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=5)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()

        assert new_node.has_received(msg.message_id)


# ===========================================================================
# (i) Network partition and recovery
# ===========================================================================

class TestNetworkPartition:
    def test_messages_during_partition_dont_leak(self):
        """Messages sent while partitioned should not cross the partition after heal."""
        net = Network()
        # Create two groups
        group_a = [make_node(fanout=3) for _ in range(3)]
        group_b = [make_node(fanout=3) for _ in range(3)]
        all_nodes = group_a + group_b

        for n in all_nodes:
            net.add_node(n)

        # Fully connect within groups
        for nodes in (group_a, group_b):
            for i, n1 in enumerate(nodes):
                for j, n2 in enumerate(nodes):
                    if i != j:
                        net.connect(n1, n2)

        # Connect groups via one link
        net.connect(group_a[0], group_b[0])

        # Partition: disconnect the bridge
        net.disconnect(group_a[0], group_b[0])

        # Send message in group A during partition
        msg_a = Message(ttl_seconds=5, channel_id="ch", payload=b"partition-msg")
        envelope_a = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg_a, hops=5)
        group_a[0].broadcast(envelope_a, net)
        net.deliver_all()

        # group_b nodes should NOT have received it
        for n in group_b:
            assert not n.has_received(msg_a.message_id), (
                "Message leaked across partition"
            )

        # Reconnect
        net.connect(group_a[0], group_b[0])

        # The old message should NOT propagate now (it's ephemeral, TTL-expired or already deduped)
        net.deliver_all()
        for n in group_b:
            assert not n.has_received(msg_a.message_id), (
                "Old message leaked after partition healed"
            )

    def test_new_messages_after_recovery_propagate(self):
        """After partition is healed, new messages propagate normally."""
        net = Network()
        group_a = [make_node(fanout=3) for _ in range(2)]
        group_b = [make_node(fanout=3) for _ in range(2)]

        for n in group_a + group_b:
            net.add_node(n)

        for g in (group_a, group_b):
            if len(g) > 1:
                net.connect(g[0], g[1])

        # Partition
        # (no cross-group link yet)

        # Heal partition
        net.connect(group_a[0], group_b[0])

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"post-recovery")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=10)
        group_a[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()

        for n in group_b:
            assert n.has_received(msg.message_id)


# ===========================================================================
# Additional edge-case tests
# ===========================================================================

class TestHopCounter:
    def test_message_with_zero_hops_not_forwarded(self):
        """A message with hop=0 should not be forwarded beyond the receiving node."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=3)
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"no-forward")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=0)

        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()

        # nodes[0] itself has it, but it should not forward to others
        # (or at most direct neighbours get it but don't forward further)
        # At minimum: with hops=0, the message should not propagate beyond direct peers
        # The exact semantics depend on implementation; at least nodes 2 hops away shouldn't get it
        # In a 3-node fully connected mesh, all are direct peers, so let's use a chain
        pass  # The topology test below is more precise

    def test_hop_counter_limits_propagation_in_chain(self):
        """In a chain A-B-C-D, hops=1 should not reach D."""
        net = Network()
        a, b, c, d = [make_node(fanout=3) for _ in range(4)]
        for n in (a, b, c, d):
            net.add_node(n)
        net.connect(a, b)
        net.connect(b, c)
        net.connect(c, d)

        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"limited")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=1)
        a.broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()

        # With hops=1, should reach at most B and maybe C but not D
        assert not d.has_received(msg.message_id)


class TestMessageEnvelope:
    def test_envelope_from_message_preserves_fields(self):
        msg = Message(
            ttl_seconds=120,
            channel_id="test-ch",
            payload=b"payload-data",
        )
        env = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=7)
        assert env.message_id == msg.message_id
        assert env.created_ts == msg.created_ts
        assert env.ttl_seconds == msg.ttl_seconds
        assert env.channel_id == msg.channel_id
        assert env.payload == msg.payload
        assert env.hops == 7

    def test_message_has_unique_id(self):
        m1 = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"a")
        m2 = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"a")
        assert m1.message_id != m2.message_id


class TestCrypto:
    def test_symmetric_encrypt_decrypt_roundtrip(self):
        key = os.urandom(32)
        plaintext = b"test symmetric encryption"
        ct = symmetric_encrypt(key, plaintext)
        pt = symmetric_decrypt(key, ct)
        assert pt == plaintext

    def test_symmetric_decrypt_wrong_key_fails(self):
        key = os.urandom(32)
        wrong = os.urandom(32)
        ct = symmetric_encrypt(key, b"data")
        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            symmetric_decrypt(wrong, ct)

    def test_sign_verify_roundtrip(self):
        priv, pub = generate_keypair()
        data = b"sign this data"
        sig = sign(priv, data)
        assert verify(pub, data, sig)

    def test_verify_tampered_data_fails(self):
        priv, pub = generate_keypair()
        sig = sign(priv, b"original")
        assert not verify(pub, b"tampered", sig)

    def test_asymmetric_encrypt_decrypt_roundtrip(self):
        priv, pub = generate_x25519_keypair()
        plaintext = b"asymmetric test"
        ct = asymmetric_encrypt(pub, plaintext)
        pt = asymmetric_decrypt(priv, ct)
        assert pt == plaintext


class TestDirectMessage:
    def test_direct_message_encrypt_decrypt(self):
        """Direct messages are encrypted to a specific recipient's public key."""
        sender_priv, sender_pub = generate_x25519_keypair()
        recip_priv, recip_pub = generate_x25519_keypair()

        dm = DirectMessage()
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="dm", payload=b"hello directly")
        encrypted = dm.encrypt_for_recipient(msg, recip_pub)

        decrypted = dm.decrypt_as_recipient(encrypted, recip_priv)
        assert decrypted.payload == b"hello directly"

    def test_direct_message_wrong_recipient_key_fails(self):
        """A non-recipient cannot decrypt a direct message."""
        _, recip_pub = generate_x25519_keypair()
        other_priv, _ = generate_x25519_keypair()

        dm = DirectMessage()
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="dm", payload=b"private")
        encrypted = dm.encrypt_for_recipient(msg, recip_pub)

        with pytest.raises(Exception):
            dm.decrypt_as_recipient(encrypted, other_priv)


class TestNodeIdentity:
    def test_node_has_keypair(self):
        """Each node has an Ed25519 keypair."""
        node = make_node()
        assert node.public_key is not None
        assert node.private_key is not None

    def test_node_ids_are_unique(self):
        nodes = [make_node() for _ in range(10)]
        ids = [n.node_id for n in nodes]
        assert len(set(ids)) == 10


class TestNetworkSimulation:
    def test_network_with_packet_loss(self):
        """With 100% packet loss, no messages should be delivered."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=3, packet_loss=1.0)
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"lost")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=5)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        for n in nodes[1:]:
            assert not n.has_received(msg.message_id)

    def test_network_with_zero_loss_delivers(self):
        """With 0% packet loss, messages should be delivered."""
        net, nodes = make_network(n_nodes=3, packet_loss=0.0)
        msg = Message(ttl_seconds=60, channel_id="ch", payload=b"delivered")
        envelope = MessageEnvelope.from_message(msg, hops=5)
        nodes[0].broadcast(envelope, net)
        net.deliver_all()
        for n in nodes[1:]:
            assert n.has_received(msg.message_id)

import time
import pytest
from hermes_p2p.bloom import BloomFilter


class TestBloomFilterBasics:
    def test_empty_filter_contains_nothing(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        for i in range(100):
            assert not bf.contains(f"item-{i}")

    def test_add_and_contains(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        bf.add("hello")
        assert bf.contains("hello")

    def test_multiple_items(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        items = [f"item-{i}" for i in range(50)]
        for item in items:
            bf.add(item)
        for item in items:
            assert bf.contains(item)

    def test_memory_bytes_returns_positive(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=1000, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        assert bf.memory_bytes() > 0

    def test_memory_bytes_is_bounded(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        size_before = bf.memory_bytes()
        for i in range(10000):
            bf.add(f"x-{i}")
        size_after = bf.memory_bytes()
        # Should not grow unboundedly
        assert size_after <= size_before * 4


class TestBloomFilterRotation:
    def test_force_rotate_creates_fresh_generation(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        bf.add("keep")
        bf._force_rotate()
        # After one rotation, item should still be in the old generation
        assert bf.contains("keep")

    def test_double_rotate_evicts(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        bf.add("evict-me")
        bf._force_rotate()
        bf._force_rotate()
        assert not bf.contains("evict-me")

    def test_item_added_after_rotate_persists(self):
        bf = BloomFilter(expected_items=100, fp_rate=0.01, ttl_seconds=60)
        bf._force_rotate()
        bf.add("new-item")
        assert bf.contains("new-item")
